target.statement: Mean ROC AUC for TabPFN with random context of size k=16 on the diabetes dataset, reported as .738±.042 (mean ± 95% CI over 20 random contexts).

compute.basis: TabPFN v3 inference on 20 contexts of 16 rows each for a 768-row dataset is tiny; the main cost is installing TabPFN and downloading the pretrained model (~100 MB) and the OpenML dataset, with inference taking seconds per context on CPU.

title: Understanding Context Sampling in TabPFN on Small Tabular Datasets
